Venue: XT.com
Headline: XT Thanksgiving Giveaway——Deposit 1 USDT. Enter the Rolex draw

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Unwrap a little surprise this Thanksgiving with XT Futures Gacha! Complete KYC, join the campaign and make eligible deposits totaling at least 1 USDT to earn 1 draw, for a chance to win a Rolex Day-Date, MacBook Pro, iPhone Duo, LABUBU, or futures vouchers. Complete first-trade, daily check-in, tiered trading, and exclusive TradFi tasks—including ANT futures—to unlock more draws!
## Campaign Period
November 20, 2026, 10:00 – December 5, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
## Eligible Futures Pairs
General Futures Tasks: USDT-Margined Perpetual Futures. Eligible trading pairs are subject to those specified on the campaign page.
Exclusive TradFi Tasks: NVDAXUSDT, MUUSDT, SKHYNIXUSDT, SAMSUNGUSDT, and ANTUSDT. Qualifying trading volumes across these five designated futures pairs will be combined.
## Tasks & Draws
Tasks | Requirements | Draws
Deposit Task | Make cumulative qualifying deposits of ≥1 USDT after registration | 1
First Futures Trade | Eligible new futures traders complete their first futures trade after registration and reach ≥100 USDT in cumulative qualifying futures trading volume | 1
Daily Check-in | Reach ≥3,000 USDT in qualifying futures trading volume in a single calendar day | 1
Tiered Trading | Reach ≥5,000 USDT in cumulative qualifying futures trading volume | 1
Tiered Trading | Reach ≥10,000 USDT in cumulative qualifying futures trading volume | 2
Tiered Trading | Reach ≥50,000 USDT in cumulative qualifying futures trading volume | 3
Tiered Trading | Reach ≥150,000 USDT in cumulative qualifying futures trading volume | 10
First TradFi Trade | Eligible new TradFi futures traders complete their first trade in a designated TradFi futures pair after registration and reach ≥100 USDT in cumulative qualifying trading volume | 1
Cumulative TradFi Trading | Reach ≥50,000 USDT in cumulative qualifying trading volume across designated TradFi futures pairs | 3
Tiered trading rewards are cumulative, allowing users to earn up to 16 draw entries by completing all four tiers.
The same qualifying trade may count toward multiple eligible tasks. Trading volume from designated TradFi pairs also counts toward both general futures tasks and exclusive TradFi tasks.
Users who qualify for both first-trade tasks and complete all eligible tasks can earn up to 36 draw entries.
## Prize Pool
Prizes
Rolex Day-Date 40
14-inch MacBook Pro
iPhone Duo 2TB
LABUBU Big into Energy Blind Box
100 USDT Futures Fee-Deduction Voucher
50 USDT Futures Trial Fund Voucher
50 USDT Futures Fee-Deduction Voucher
30 USDT Futures Trial Fund Voucher
30 USDT Futures Fee-Deduction Voucher
10 USDT Futures Trial Fund Voucher
5 USDT Futures Fee-Deduction Voucher
5 USDT Futures Trial Fund Voucher
2 USDT Futures Fee-Deduction Voucher
## How to Join
Complete KYC and click “Join Now” on the campaign page.
Complete deposit or futures trading tasks for which you qualify, then claim your draws.
Head to the gacha machine and use your draws before the campaign ends.
## Terms & Conditions
Eligibility: This campaign is open to eligible regular XT users. Only qualifying deposits and trades are completed after KYC verification and campaign registration, and within the campaign period will count. Deposit, daily check-in, tiered trading, and cumulative TradFi trading tasks are available to all eligible registered participants.
First-Trade Eligibility: The First Futures Trade task is available only to users with no futures trading history before the campaign begins. The First TradFi Trade task is available only to users with no TradFi futures trading history before the campaign begins.
Eligible Deposits: Qualifying deposits include on-chain deposits, credit/debit card transactions, third-party payments, and P2P transactions. Internal transfers are excluded. Deposit amounts are calculated based on their USDT-equivalent value recognized by the campaign system.
Trading Volume Calculation: Qualifying trading volume includes executed opening and closing trades in designated USDT-Margined Perpetual Futures. Trading volume generated using trial funds will not count. Exclusive TradFi tasks only include the five designated trading pairs listed above. No qualifying trading volume can be generated during market closures, trading suspensions, or temporary delistings.
Task Calculation: Daily tasks are calculated by calendar day (UTC+8), with a maximum of one draw entry per day and 14 draw entries throughout the campaign. Tiered trading tasks are based on cumulative qualifying trading volume during the campaign. Each tier can be claimed separately, and rewards are cumulative. The cumulative TradFi trading task awards three draw entries upon reaching 50,000 USDT and can be claimed only once during the campaign.
Draw Rules: Each gacha draw consumes one draw entry, and prizes are awarded randomly. Meeting the deposit requirement does not guarantee a Rolex or any other specific prize. Draw entries are non-transferable, cannot be exchanged for cash, and must be used before the campaign ends.
Reward Distribution: Futures vouchers will be credited directly to winners' accounts after each draw and remain valid for seven days. Usage conditions are subject to the terms stated on each voucher. Physical prizes will be awarded according to the models displayed on the campaign page. Winners must complete eligibility verification and confirm the necessary prize claim details. Each LABUBU prize consists of one randomly selected blind box.
Account Restrictions: Each user may participate using only one main account. Related accounts are not eligible for duplicate rewards. Sub-accounts, market makers, brokers, institutional accounts, and API accounts are excluded.
Fair Participation: Bulk registrations, fraudulent deposits, wash trading, self-trading, and other abusive activities are strictly prohibited. XT reserves the right to disqualify participants and revoke or reclaim improperly obtained rewards if suspicious or fraudulent activity is detected.
Additional Conditions: Prize availability and remaining draw entries are subject to the information displayed on the campaign page. XT reserves the right to address abnormal participation and campaign disputes in accordance with applicable rules.

Headline: Your Winter Bootcamp mission starts here! Gear up, complete the challenges, and get a chance to claim a 100 USDT Futures Bonus from the 20,000 USDT reward pool, with…

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
- Users must join the campaign via the official announcement link from social media channel (eg: Telegram, X, Reddit, Discord) to be eligible for participation.
- Eligibility: This activity is exclusive to brand-new registered users.
- Giveaway Terms: Reward is Futures Position Airdrop. If the position incurs a loss, you will owe nothing. Users can withdraw a maximum profit of $5 USDT (5% of the position value) upon closing the position.
- Transaction volume does not count towards zero-fee transactions.
- Platform Rights: KuCoin reserves the right to disqualify users who are found to be engaging in malicious behaviors, including but not limited to wash trading, mass account registrations, or unusual trading patterns. KuCoin reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
- Apple Inc. is not a sponsor and is not affiliated with this event.
